# jimcast-plugins

> Community plugins for jimcast (a macOS command-bar launcher) written in TypeScript with @jimcast/sdk, plus an AI skill that teaches coding assistants to write new plugins.

A plugin is a small Node program that returns widget data (lists, grids, progress bars) and runs shell scripts on click. Plugins are stateless: state lives in files under ~/.jimcast/ext-<name>/.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repo map, commands, conventions
- [Skill](skills/jimcast-plugin/SKILL.md): rules and fast path for writing a plugin
- [Smallest plugin](examples/hello/src/index.ts): one file, one button
- [Full small plugin](examples/counter/src/render.ts): state file, buttons, CLI

## Plugins
- [pomodoro](plugins/pomodoro/src/render.ts): timer, progress bar, notifications
- [calendar](plugins/calendar/src/render.ts): date strip and today's tasks
- [colors](plugins/colors/src/render.ts): palettes, profiles, copy hex
- [emoji](plugins/emoji/src/render.ts): category tabs, recent, copy
